system.description:
Can target only an ally. Use when the target performs [Weapon Attack], [Magic Attack], or [Special Attack] on an enemy with the [Boss] tag. The [Hate] cost of that action is reduced by 1 (minimum 0). This skill can continue to be reused in the same round.

A special skill that encourages allies by playing a musical accompaniment to pray for good luck. A blow delivered along with this timbre becomes part of a Shinto ritual, making it less likely to arouse animosity.
